Engineering Student Council Executive Board

2026–2027

Our Committees

External Vice President Committee

Builds relationships with engineering organizations, College of Engineering partners, and other external groups, and supports programs for affiliated student organizations.

Internal Vice President Committee

Advocates for student organizations and the engineering student body, and strengthens connections between students and campus departments.

Finance Committee

Oversees ESC allocations and helps Blue & Gold organizations manage their finances.

Communications Committee

Shares ESC news and events, manages outreach and social media, and creates visual content for the engineering community.

Engineers' Week Committee

Plans Engineers' Week with corporate sponsors, student organizations, and College of Engineering partners.

Technical Committee

Maintains and develops ESC's websites, applications, and other technology systems.
